title: Weeping Aloud
text: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it.

title: I Am Joseph
text: I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?

title: To Save Lives
text: … it was to save lives that God sent me before you.

title: Not You, but God
text: Therefore it was not you who sent me here, but God …

title: Wept and Embraced
text: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him.

title: Pharaoh Was Pleased
text: When the news reached Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.

title: Five Sets of Clothes
text: … but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

title: Do Not Quarrel
text: Do not quarrel on the way!

title: The Spirit of Jacob Revived
text: … the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.

title: Joseph Wept Profusely
text: Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.

title: Now I Can Die
text: Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!

title: The Land of Goshen
text: They may dwell in the land of Goshen.

title: Jacob Breathed His Last
text: … he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last, and he was gathered to his people.

title: What If Joseph Bears a Grudge?
text: What if Joseph bears a grudge?

title: Please Forgive
text: … please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.

title: We Are Your Slaves
text: We are your slaves!

title: Am I in the Place of God?
text: Do not be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

title: God Intended It for Good
text: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.

title: Spoke Kindly
text: So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them.

title: Joseph's Grandchildren
text: He saw Ephraim’s sons to the third generation …

title: Carry My Bones
text: God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.

title: Joseph Died
text: So Joseph died at the age of 110.

title: Five Sets of Clothes
text: … but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

title: Heard Through the Walls
text: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him …

title: Goshen
text: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me …
